description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate the Oracle JDBC data source, JPA dialect, SQL syntax, and schema definitions to Azure Database for PostgreSQL, including converting Oracle BLOB storage to PostgreSQL bytea.
tasks.reason: Azure Database for PostgreSQL provides a fully managed, cloud-native relational database service for the application.
tasks.requirements: Migrate the Oracle JDBC data source, JPA dialect, SQL syntax, and schema definitions to Azure Database for PostgreSQL. Replace the Oracle JDBC driver with the PostgreSQL driver, update Spring datasource configuration and Hibernate dialect, convert Oracle-specific SQL in repositories to PostgreSQL-compatible equivalents, and migrate BLOB storage to bytea.
